# Industrial Process Steam (IndustrialProcessSteam)

> **Class**: `IndustrialProcessSteam` | **Module**: `energysim.models.loads` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Industrial process steam demand header for refineries and chemical plants.

Quasi-static: demand = setpoint (>= 0), deficit = max(0, demand - supply),
thermal demand = demand x enthalpy. No header pressure dynamics.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'SteamHeader'` | - | Unique component name identifier |
| `nominal_demand_t_hr` | `float` | `100.0` | t/h | Nominal process steam demand |
| `enthalpy_kj_kg` | `float` | `2800.0` | kJ/kg | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Inputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `steam_supply_t_hr` | t/h | - |
| `demand_setpoint_t_hr` | t/h | - |

## Outputs

| Variable | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `steam_demand_t_hr` | t/h | Process steam demand |
| `steam_deficit_t_hr` | t/h | Unmet steam demand |
| `Q_demand_MW_th` | MW | - |

## Validity and notes

Validity: quasi-static demand header; no pressure, temperature or condensate-return dynamics;
constant specific enthalpy.

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import IndustrialProcessSteam

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('industrialprocesssteam', model=IndustrialProcessSteam(), outputs=['steam_demand_t_hr', 'steam_deficit_t_hr', 'Q_demand_MW_th'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['industrialprocesssteam'].tail(2))
```
